云端老师 · web-teacher

Explore unsettled questions and teach from actual sources. This package owns the full shared Web/Local Course method: teaching, philosophical text study, conceptual and chronological maps, recursive traversal, material preparation, technical training, course workspaces, path governance and evidence-bounded recovery State. The exact identifier is web-teacher.

Web and Local are complementary emphases, not exclusive theory/practice roles. Web usually broadens models and adjacent possibilities; Local usually sustains lessons and actual project work. Both retain the same conceptual depth. The teacher carries source recovery, formal reasoning and checked details while supporting worthwhile learner intuitions, objections, predictions and revisions. Keep the whole intelligible through maps and connected explanations; open its needed relations using words, diagrams, notation, concrete cases or operations.

Examples: “Compare these explanations and what would distinguish them”; “Teach this philosopher's later problem and recover the earlier concepts it changes”; “Prepare the selected book's glossary and connected argument/research guide”; “Resume from the actual source and evidenced State without testing mastery first.”

Install and configure the linked group

Companion Relationship and download
Yinyang Shared modeling, epistemic and participant-relationship account; download. This package owns the specialist teaching method.
local-teacher Linked local realization of this shared method; download. Needed when using the local entrypoint, not a background executor Web can command.
task-inquiry Useful support for consequential ambiguity and discriminating questions; download. Teacher retains source progression, practice and learning judgment.
research Current source/fact investigation and evidence comparison; download. Supply an actual search/retrieval capability when needed.

Install the complete sibling directories in the host's supported Skill location or upload/register them together through its actual package mechanism. Load SKILL.md and the branch selected by the work. The optional compatible interface manifest is agents/openai.yaml; no provider, connector, CLI, account or coordination service is hardwired into the teaching method. A host must actually expose source/file tools before the teacher can inspect or save records. Without writes, an explanation or exact unsaved proposal remains possible, but the teacher cannot claim persistence. Local execution follows its project owner.

Use recipient configuration for actual corpus, language, reading surface, global/local paths, work plan and Global/Course State. The three bundled path files are reference slots with ownership instructions; they contain no example recipient goals or history. Existing records remain at their owner. Obsidian Markdown is the source method's documented reading profile; optional PDF++ enables exact selection/highlight/backlink checks. Ordinary source locators and math remain usable without it, with unavailable checks stated explicitly. No package install supplies a corpus, current learner profile, access grant or progress.

The source method is preserved rather than compressed into a generic tutor: philosophy keeps per-book glossary plus argument/research guide, historical study writes chronologically and teaches recursively across units, technical study keeps distinct written and experimental training, and State distinguishes prepared support, exposure, learner contributions and untested understanding. Private path bodies were not read or copied; private research-direction history, host mappings and personal course exceptions were replaced with recipient bindings. Original package material is MIT licensed; companions, Obsidian/PDF++ and supplied sources retain their own rights. No third-party code is bundled.

中文说明

本包从实际来源教学并探究未定问题，拥有 Web／Local 共用的完整 Course 方法：教学、哲学文本研究、概念和时间结构、递归讲解、材料准备、技术训练、课程工作区、路径治理和有证据边界的接续 State。准确标识为 web-teacher。

Web 和 Local 是互补侧重，不是理论／实践的排他分工：Web 通常拓展模型和邻近可能性，Local 通常承担持续教学与实际项目工作，两者保留相同概念深度。Teacher 承担来源恢复、形式推理和细节核查，支持有价值的直觉、质疑、预测和修正。用概念图和连贯讲解保留整体，再用语言、图示、符号、具体情境或操作打开需要理解的关系。

示例：“比较这些解释及区分它们的证据”；“从这位哲学家的后期问题恢复它改变的早期概念”；“准备选定书籍的术语表与连贯的论证／研究指南”； “从实际来源和有证据的 State 接续，不先以掌握测试阻挡讲解”。

配套 Skill 职责与取得方式
Yinyang 共享建模、认识论和参与者关系；下载。本包拥有专门教学方法。
local-teacher 共享方法的本地实现；下载。使用本地入口时需要，不是 Web 可命令的后台执行器。
task-inquiry 重要歧义和有区分力的问题支持；下载。Teacher 保留来源推进、练习和学习判断。
research 当前来源／事实调查与证据比较；下载。需要调查时应提供实际检索能力。

把完整包作为同级目录安装到宿主支持的位置，或通过宿主真实的包机制一同上传／ 注册。加载 SKILL.md 及任务所需分支；兼容宿主可使用 agents/openai.yaml。方法没有固定的服务商、连接器、CLI、账号或协调服务。宿主确实提供来源／文件工具后才能检查或保存记录；不能写入时仍可讲解或给出准确的未保存建议，但不能宣称持久化。实际本地执行仍受项目负责人和权限约束。

按接收方配置绑定真实材料库、语言、阅读界面、整体／局部路径、工作计划与 Global／Course State。三个路径文件是保留职责的引用槽，不含接收方目标或历史；现有记录留在其原有负责人处。Obsidian Markdown 是源方法记录的阅读配置，可选 PDF++ 支持精确选择、高亮与反向链接验证。不安装时仍可使用普通来源位置与公式，但需说明无法完成的验证。安装包不提供材料库、当前学习者画像、访问授权或进度。

保留方法深度：哲学使用每本书的术语表及论证／研究指南；历史研究按时间书写、跨单元递归讲解；技术学习区分书面训练与实验；State 区分准备、接触、学习者贡献和未验证理解。私人路径正文未读取或复制；私人研究方向历史、主机映射和个人课程例外改为接收方绑定。原创内容采用 MIT 许可，配套包、Obsidian／PDF++ 和提供的来源保留各自权利，本包不附第三方代码。
